questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Costume design?

options.text: It is the creation of clothing that communicates character, social status, and historical period.
It is the application of cosmetics and prosthetics to alter an actor's physical appearance.
It is an artificial body part applied to change an actor's physical form.
It is the maintenance of identical clothing details across shots filmed at different times.
options.misconception: Confuses Costume design with Costume continuity

questions.explanation: It is the creation of clothing that communicates character, social status, and historical period. This is precisely what Costume design means; the alternatives describe Makeup, Prosthetic, Costume continuity, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Costume design.
